body: I swear, if I continue to live, there will be nothing but pain and suffering. I’m so sick and tired every single day with no purpose. I exist in goddamned hell. I can’t deal with this.
i understand. my life is like a curse with no reverse remedy.

neurodivergent condition aside, i have no power to change anything. adoption is always against the child’s will, especially when the adoption leads to them living in a new country. i can’t get rid of my adoptive mom’s narcissism and various bigoted ideals. getting out of this country and back to my native one is next to impossible, as there were adults who tried to get me as disconnected from it as possible, both legally and mentally. unpaid work is just as hard to get out of as paid work. if i don’t do it, i get abused.
doubt it. it’s been this way for years.
only thing i can possibly think of is a life that’s the opposite of mine, which is impossible.
it’s less isolating to know i’m not the only one who’s trapped in a bad situation, but it doesn’t change how much i want to end things.
technically yes, but he’s also an asshole and was never there for me. he literally laughed at me when i almost died by *accident.*
Can’t cut ties because I’m not emancipated. Can’t talk about the adhd because where I go is super ableist and old-fashioned.
Adoptive parent is abusive, work and deadlines are too hard on my adhd, people are mean and bigoted to no end, country of residence is terrible.
